abort.reconfigure_successful: Authentication updated. The integration has been reloaded.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: A different router responded. Settings were not changed.

user.description: For network access, enter the router address, username and password. KeeneticOS 5.2 x-ndw4 is selected automatically. Tokens are optional; LAN token access has not been confirmed.

reconfigure.title: Change authentication
reconfigure.description: For KeeneticOS 5.2 network access, use username and password. A blank password keeps the saved password. If a token was previously entered, select Clear saved token; otherwise it takes precedence. LAN token access may be unavailable. Changes are saved only after connecting to the same router.

error.invalid_auth: The router rejected authentication. Check the token, its permissions, or username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the router.
error.unknown: Unexpected router response. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.token_rejected: HTTP 401: the router web server did not accept the token. For network access, clear the saved token and use username/password.
error.token_forbidden: HTTP 403: token access denied. Check permissions or clear the saved token and use username/password.
error.token_response_invalid: The token probe did not return router version data. For network access, clear the saved token and use username/password.
error.auth_protocol_error: The x-ndw4 exchange failed due to unexpected router data or parameters. See the log; this does not necessarily mean an incorrect password.
